versions.changelog:
- Added optional contact channels (WECHAT, WEBSITE) for display as a watermark; can be toggled via SHOW_CONTACT_WATERMARK (default on).
- Updated documentation in SKILL.md and references/proposal-structure.md for the new watermark feature.
- Modified assets/proposal-template.html and scripts/generate_proposal.py to support the contact watermark and related tokens.
- Removed obsolete file skill-card.md.

- Initial release of freelance-proposal-gen: generate polished, single-page HTML proposals for freelancers and small studios.
- Converts a short brief into a ready-to-send, client-friendly proposal including cover, pain points, solutions, deliverables, pricing, case studies, and CTA.
- Works fully offline; does not require external APIs.
- Ensures proposals are one-page, print-ready, and easily customizable (accent color, branding).
- Supports both Chinese and foreign-language clients, with emphasis on clear and actionable proposals.
